Here is the adjusted email, rewritten to be more professional, empathetic, and encouraging for a job applicant:

Subject: Update on your application for the Marketing position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Marketing position and for sharing your qualifications with us. We truly appreciated the opportunity to review your background.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with our current needs. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills, as we were impressed by your application.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page for future openings that may be a better match for your expertise. We wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
